brief:
Israeli attacks killed 19 Palestinians in the Gaza Strip over the past 48 hours, Al Jazeera reported, citing the Ministry of Health. The ministry provided no details on where the strikes occurred or how the deaths happened.

The deaths are part of the broader casualty toll from the conflict that began in October 2023, when Israeli military operations intensified across Gaza.
dek: Gaza’s health ministry says 19 Palestinians killed by Israeli attacks in 48 hours Israeli attacks have killed 19 Palestinians in the past 48 hours in the Gaza Strip, Al Jazeera reported, citing the Ministry of Health.
title: Israeli attacks kill 19 Palestinians in Gaza within 48 hours
